metadata.description: Name of the azd environment; used to derive resource names and the resource group.

EU Data Zone region for all resources. Foundry Data Zone Standard deployments keep data within the EU. Verified GPT-5 availability regions include swedencentral, westeurope, francecentral, polandcentral.
Object id of the user/service principal running the deploy. Granted data-plane roles so a human can also use the resources. azd populates AZURE_PRINCIPAL_ID.

When true, provision a VNet + Private Endpoints + Private DNS and disable public access on the AI/data services (matches the "no public internet" architecture). When false, fall back to the public-with-managed-identity setup so anyone without networking quota can still `azd up`.
Tutor / general reasoning model deployment name.
Cheap routing + GraphRAG entity-extraction model deployment name.
Deep reasoning model deployment name (essay correction, hard-question validation).
LLM-as-judge model deployment name for evaluations.
Backend container image. azd replaces this on deploy.
Frontend container image. azd replaces this on deploy.
Container Apps infrastructure subnet prefix (workload profiles need >= /27; /23 gives ample room).

principalIds.value: [union(createArray(reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('rg-{0}', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'identity'), '2025-04-01').outputs.principalId.value), if(empty(parameters('principalId')), createArray(), createArray(parameters('principalId'))))]
